purpose: Teach: 反転/利潤/インフォメーション/呼称/ジレンマ/主たる/オファー/売上げ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪率の反転を目指しております
lines.en: We're working to reverse the crime rate in this area.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Formal register without stiffness. Even pacing, professional composure. Slight pause after the period — a briefing tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、利潤目的の犯罪を追跡されていますね
lines.en: Yes. You're tracking profit-motivated crimes specifically, aren't you?
lines.style: Engaged and respectful. Question rises slightly at the end—showing attentiveness to the officer's work. Warm but not familiar. Nod-forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域インフォメーションを発信しております
lines.en: We're also distributing community information regularly.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact continuation. No inflection seeking approval. Steady, methodical. The tone of someone checking boxes in a briefing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、容疑者の呼称を慎重にされていますね
lines.en: I see. And you're being careful with how you refer to suspects in those announcements.
lines.style: Approving observation. Recognises the thoughtfulness without overdoing it. Warm nod of understanding. Pace steady, slightly slower — showing he's noted something good.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査のジレンマを抱えております
lines.en: We do face a real dilemma in the investigation process, though.
lines.style: Slight shift—honesty breaking through procedure. Quieter admission. The moment where the officer allows something genuine into the formal conversation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察の主たる業務、頼もしいです
lines.en: Yes. The police's main responsibility is genuinely reassuring.
lines.style: Sincere affirmation. Not flattery—respect. Slower pace here, weight on the words. The voice of someone who means what he's saying.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者からの司法取引オファーを慎重に検討しております
lines.en: We're being careful to consider any plea bargain offers from suspects.
lines.style: Back to procedure. Formal, deliberate pacing. Each phrase carefully weighted. Returns to the briefing register—protective of the process.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域防犯の売上げ効果が出ているそうですね
lines.en: That's good to hear—the community crime-prevention work seems to be showing real results.
lines.style: Warm, closer now. A small smile in the voice. Personal observation cutting through formality. Slower, more genuine—the conversation softening after the harder topics.
